My experience with your company has been very bad. I saw your courier service on YouTube and chose your company because I urgently needed to send clothes and other items from Mumbai to Uttar Pradesh for my sister’s wedding.

Then my sister called me, so I contacted the Andheri branch because I booked the courier from there. But the employee from the Andheri branch spoke very rudely with me, and because of that we had an argument on the call.

After that, I called the Uttar Pradesh branch where my courier had reached. They told me to collect the parcel from their office. But the next day when my family went there, they said that the courier had already been returned to Mumbai.

Again, I messaged the Andheri branch, but there was no reply. Then I called them. Even though it was not my mistake, I still said sorry to them. But they told me that they would neither return my courier nor refund my money because during our first argument I said that I would come to the branch.

Now it has been 20–25 days, and neither my courier has been returned nor have I received my refund.

Is this the way you treat customers? At the time of booking and payment, you talk very politely, but after receiving payment, you treat customers like this.

I do not want anything else. Please just return my courier and refund my money.

THEFT ALERT!
This has been an extremely frustrating and unacceptable experience with the international courier service used for my shipment.

A parcel sent from India to Germany arrived incomplete, with multiple valuable personal items missing, including clothing and accessories. The package was delivered, but items were clearly removed or lost somewhere during transit, and no one involved is taking responsibility.

No clear explanation has been provided regarding weight scans, handling records, or whether the parcel was opened, tampered with, or repacked at any stage. Customer support has been unhelpful and has not provided any meaningful investigation or resolution.

What is even more unacceptable is that the shipment documentation did not accurately reflect the full contents in the first place, making it even harder to track what went wrong and where.

At this point, it feels like there is either severe mishandling or internal loss of items somewhere in the logistics chain, and yet there is no proper claim process being honored and no willingness to resolve the issue.

This entire experience has been extremely disappointing and has destroyed trust in the service.

I strongly warn others to be extremely cautious when sending valuable personal belongings internationally. Always document and photograph every item before packing, because once something goes missing, there is apparently no accountability or proper resolution process.
